name: org_graph_as_of
description: Read the Org Graph as it stood on one UTC date: the live units with their parent, level, owners and direct member count, and the number of employed people. A future date includes changes already recorded for it, such as a hire who starts then or a scheduled move. known_on reads what the Org Graph knew at 23:59:59 UTC on that earlier date, not in the tenant's local time, leaving out corrections learned since. mode "full" adds each employed person's facts (title, level, manager, site, employment) and every membership. unit_id narrows to that unit and the units under it, counting only the people placed there. People are named by id only.

known_on.description: UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for what is known now.
